title: Why Does Ohtani Earn Just $2.6M Playing?
description:
Why does one of baseball's biggest stars earn only 2.6 million dollars from playing?

Sources:
- Forbes: The World's 10 Highest-Paid Athletes 2026 (Forbes Australia): https://www.forbes.com.au/news/sport/the-worlds-10-highest-paid-athletes-2026/

Forbes estimate for May 1, 2025 to May 1, 2026: $127.6M total, $2.6M on-field, $125M off-field. Not financial advice.

#shorts #ohtani #baseball #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time you watch a baseball game, ask yourself:

scenes.narration: Why does one of baseball's biggest stars earn only 2.6 million dollars from playing?
Shohei Ohtani signed a 700 million dollar, ten-year deal in December 2023.
But most of that money is pushed to yearly payments that start in 2034.

visual.stat_sub: when most of it gets paid

scenes.narration: So in Forbes' latest count, his baseball pay was about 2.6 million, bonuses included.
Off the field, he made about 125 million dollars from more than 20 sponsors.
Forbes says nobody on its list earned more off the field.

sources.title: Forbes: The World's 10 Highest-Paid Athletes 2026 (Forbes Australia)
